desc: Derive ancestor and joint-ancestor probabilities for a fixed edge vertex \(i\), and obtain the expected distance formula for arbitrary \(u,v\).
Simplify the formula into \(O(1)\)-query expressions using weighted prefix sums and modular inverses.
Determine preprocessing, factorial scaling, and all special cases involving vertex \(1\), equal endpoints if relevant, and endpoint edge indices.
Implement the stdin/stdout algorithm within \(O(N+Q)\) or \(O((N+Q)\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
Validate the implementation against all provided samples.
